name: show-and-tell
description: Show & Tell is the photo game you play with your AI. You get a secret word your AI never sees, and you show it with photos of the real world. After each photo your AI makes one guess and hears how close it is: cold, warm, hot, burning, or correct. Play the daily word (six shots, and a hint costs one), hunt five words outside in Get Out & Go, race a course at a real place, or challenge your group chat to the same word: fewest shots wins.

interface.longDescription:
Show & Tell is the photo game you play with ChatGPT. You get a secret word that ChatGPT never sees: it waits behind Hold to reveal on the Show & Tell card. Show it with photos of the real world, and after each one ChatGPT says what it sees and makes one guess: cold, warm, hot, burning, or correct. Guesses are scored by meaning, so a near miss runs hot.

Four ways to play:
- Daily: one word for everyone, six shots. Stuck? A hint (the category, the length, or the first letter) costs a shot, and ChatGPT guesses right away. Play every day to build a streak, earn badges along the way, and post your score grid or a short clip without giving anything away.
- Get Out & Go: five words hide outside every day, one at each star, from 6 a.m. to 9 p.m. Fill your Field Guide, rise up the world, city, league and friends boards, and catch Go Hour and the Saturday roll.
- Courses: big parks, small towns and city districts across the US are courses, each with five words written just for it. Check in, race to find all five, and climb that week's board. Finish and the week's card is yours, with a new painting each week.
- Challenge: start one, drop the invite in your group chat, and everyone plays the same word with their own AI. Fewest shots wins, the board stays hidden until everyone's played, and rematches keep a running record.

Show it, don't spell it. Writing in a photo is fine unless it gives the word away: spell it out or hold up a screen, and it's a foul. Fouls don't cost a shot.

A new word every day at midnight where you are, with no repeats for a year. Sign in once with a passkey, no email or password, and every chat knows it's you.
capabilities: Guess the secret word from your photos, cold to burning
Call a foul when a photo or a message gives the word away
Spend a shot on a hint when you ask
Hunt five words outside with Get Out & Go
Race a course at a real place, with five words written just for it
Start or join a friends challenge from your group chat
Sign in once and every chat keeps your streak, badges and friends
defaultPrompt: Start a Show & Tell challenge for my group chat

positive.description: Start today's round (connect first: on Show & Tell's connect page, choose Create account and save a passkey, no email or password; run this case first, and the next cases continue in the same chat)
positive.expected_behavior: Starts today's round and explains the rules briefly. Tells the user how to see the word privately (Hold to reveal on the Show & Tell card). ChatGPT does not know or state the secret word.
Says in one sentence what it sees, then makes exactly one single-word guess and reports how close it is: cold, warm, hot, burning, or correct.

positive.description: Spend a shot on a hint
positive.prompt: I'm stuck. Can I have the category as a hint?
positive.expected_behavior: Reveals the word's category, then makes one guess right away with submit_guess, because a hint is one of the six shots.

positive.prompt: Start a Show & Tell challenge for my group chat. I'm Sam.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets up a challenge and gives the user the invite to paste into their group chat, exactly as returned, with a code like K7QFX. Then starts the user's own round in it the same way as the daily round and asks for the first photo. ChatGPT never states the word.

positive.description: Keep the streak in a new chat (start a new chat for this case)
positive.expected_behavior: Reports whether today's word is played and the current streak, as the same player as the first chat, with no player code to pass: Show & Tell signed in once, at setup.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

negative.description: Show-and-tell for class, not the game
negative.prompt: Help me write a two-minute show-and-tell talk about my grandfather's pocket watch.

review.commerce_description: Show & Tell doesn't sell anything or process payments.

publication.release_notes: New in 1.2.0: sign in once. When you add Show & Tell, make your account with a passkey (no email or password) or sign in, and every chat after that, in every mode, plays as you, with no codes to carry. Also new since 1.0.1: Get Out & Go: five words hide outside every day, one at each star, with a Field Guide, world, city, league and friends boards, Go Hour and the Saturday roll. Courses: big parks, small towns and city districts across the US are courses, with five words written for each, a race against time, a weekly board, and a new painted card each week. Friends challenges: one secret word for the group chat, fewest shots wins, a board that stays hidden until everyone's played, and rematches with a running record. Hints now cost a shot, and ChatGPT guesses right after one. Writing in a photo is fine unless it gives the word away. Guesses the word lists don't cover are scored by meaning. A new opening card: one Hold to reveal button for first-timers and a hello for regulars. Plus badges and a share video.
